ordered_branches.explanation: Reads header company by scalar subquery. If NULL or fixed empty sentinel, collects DISTINCT detail companies for the shipment; loops in descending row-number position ordered by company and appends escaped company constants as columns, normalizing NULL to fixed sentinel. No details falls back to header company column. Fixed nvarchar4000 SQL string adds WHERE internal shipment number and executes. Missing header returns no final rows; NULL ID nulls the composed SQL. Shape grows with distinct companies and can exceed string capacity. This supplies context; it does not authorize access itself.

FROM SHIPMENT_HEADER SH inner join SHIPMENT_DETAIL SD
with Records AS(select row_number() over(order by Company) as N'<literal:5>', * from @TempCompanies) select @CurrentCompany = Company from records where row = @NumberOfCompanies;
SET @CurrentColumnName = N'<literal:9>' + cast(@NumberOfCompanies as nvarchar(25)) + N'<literal:10>';
